title: Symmetric-group conjugacy classes admit cyclic descent extensions exactly outside rectangular cycle types with square-free cycle length
author: Adin, Ron M.; Hegedüs, Pál; Roichman, Yuval
work: Higher Lie characters and cyclic descent extension on conjugacy classes
source_version: Algebraic Combinatorics 6 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/alco.323; exact archived official publisher native/PDF
difficulty_reason: The characterization requires constructing the nonnegative near-hook coefficient condition for higher Lie characters and proving it through divisor-sensitive estimates and a rectangular character product expansion. Classical cyclic-tableau and character-theory results alone do not give the conjugacy-class classification; the complete new hook and positivity core remains a proof obligation. Exceptional cycle parameters and the supporting hook-unimodality result are part of this one outcome.
